Customer name: Sanne de Vries
Policy number: DH-1001
Date of damage: 3 November 2026
What happened: A hailstorm broke six roof tiles and cracked the skylight above the stairs. Rain is now coming in.
Damage: Six broken roof tiles and a cracked skylight
Estimated cost: EUR 1,850
claim_1_covered.txt.policy:
Decision: COVERED
Reason: Hail damage to the building is covered by policy DH-1001. The deductible of EUR 250 applies.
Payout: EUR 1,600

claim_2_not_covered.txt.intake:
Customer name: Mehmet Yilmaz
Policy number: DH-2002
Date of damage: 3 November 2026
What happened: A heavy hailstorm damaged the roof and broke the skylight in the attic.
Damage: Damaged roof and broken attic skylight
Estimated cost: EUR 2,400
claim_2_not_covered.txt.policy:
Decision: NOT COVERED
Reason: Policy DH-2002 insures only belongings inside the home. Damage to the roof and skylight is damage to the building, which is not insured.
Payout: EUR 0
claim_2_not_covered.txt.letter:
DRAFT - to be checked by a claims handler

Dear Mehmet Yilmaz,

Thank you for reporting the hail damage of 3 November 2026.

Your policy is a contents insurance. It covers your belongings inside the home, but not the building itself. The roof and the skylight are part of the building, so we cannot pay for this repair.

If your belongings were damaged as well, please let us know.

Kind regards,
Claims desk, Demo Home Insurance (a fictional insurer)
